input.new_string:
"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import secrets
import time

SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 14  # 14 days


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    issued_at = int(time.time())
    expires_at = issued_at + SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS
    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

    payload = f"{user_id}:{session_id}:{expires_at}"
    signature = hmac.new(
        secret.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()

    return {
        "user_id": user_id,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "issued_at": issued_at,
        "expires_at": expires_at,
        "signature": signature,
        "cookie": {
            "name": "auth_state",
            "value": f"{session_id}.{signature}",
            "http_only": True,
            "secure": True,
            "same_site": "Lax",
            "max_age": SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS,
        },
    }
